status: UNVERIFIED PLACEHOLDER. The index SCALE (0,1,3,6,10,16,24...) and the sequence-model parameter layouts below are reproduced from the example workbook (ASSY WITH PRESS OPERATION.xlsx) plus publicly taught MOST fundamentals. The per-parameter real-world cutoffs in 'guidance' (distance/weight/etc. ranges that determine which index applies) are NOT sourced from a licensed H.B. Maynard MOST manual and must not be treated as the official standard. Do not ship a production study on these cutoffs until the MOST license status is confirmed and the real index-range tables are substituted here -- no code changes required to swap them, only this file.
tmu_formula: For Data Card in {G, C, T}: TMU = SUM(active parameter index values in the row) * 10 * FREQ. For Data Card PT: TMU = FREQ * seconds_value / 0.036. This is pure arithmetic, verified against the cached values in the example workbook -- it is not a per-index lookup.

PT.name: Process Time
parameter_labels: Process Time (raw seconds, not an index)

A.name: Action Distance
A.guidance_unverified: 0 = no movement; 1 = within reach, <=20cm; 3 = ~20-45cm (one step or arm extension); 6 = ~45-90cm (one step and reach); 10 = ~90-135cm (two steps); 16 = >135cm (walk).

B.name: Body Motion
B.guidance_unverified: 0 = no body motion; 1 = bend/sit/stand (partial); 3 = bend and arise, sit/stand; 6 = walk one or two steps to a new location; 10 = walk several steps / climb.

G.name: Gain Control
G.guidance_unverified: 0 = already controlled / no grasp needed; 1 = simple grasp of one light, easy-to-reach object; 3 = grasp requiring care, multiple objects, or blind grasp; 6 = grasp requiring search or awkward positioning.

P.name: Placement
P.guidance_unverified: 0 = toss/release with no care; 1 = obtain control at destination; 3 = adjust to fit/align loosely; 6 = careful adjustment/orientation; 10 = precise fit against resistance; 16 = highly precise, multiple adjustments.

M.name: Move Controlled
M.guidance_unverified: Distance moved under control (e.g. sliding/pushing a part along a guided path). Same distance bands as Action Distance, applied to controlled travel rather than free reach.

X.name: Process Time (within Controlled Move)
X.guidance_unverified: Index representing wait time embedded in a controlled move (e.g. machine engaging), on the standard index scale rather than raw seconds.

I.name: Alignment
I.guidance_unverified: 0 = no alignment needed; 1 = light contact alignment; 3 = alignment requiring adjustment; 6 = precise alignment (fasteners, guide pins); 10 = very tight tolerance alignment.

T.name: Tool Action
T.guidance_unverified: Index for the tool-use action itself (e.g. fasten, cut, press); scales with number of tool cycles/turns per the tool-use sub-table. Highly tool-specific -- flagged as the parameter most in need of the real licensed table.
